entities.title: god-string
entities.summary: A recreation of the god-string used in iPulse: The Great String War, a series of articles about GString, and a speculative reconstruction of GString's headers.
entities.purpose: The repository root holds the README a person reads first, the articles in articles/, the headers in src/, the actor the .dev files name in Actors/, the skills and knowledge catalogue the .dev files follow in Meta/Agents/, and the agent instructions in AGENTS.md.
boundaries: Nothing here is built, tested by a workflow or deployed; the only check of the code is the headers' syntax check, run by hand.
The published articles live in the icelander.net repository; this repository keeps the working copies.
Meta/Agents/Skills and Meta/Agents/Knowledge are copies from the human-assisted-software-development repository, changed there and copied here.
